create_single_directory: create a single directory at a given path if it does not already exist
create_multiple_directories: create multiple directories from a list of paths that do not yet exist
mkdir_wrapper: wrap os.makedirs with an existence check to safely create a directory path
batch_mkdir: batch create directories by passing a list of paths to mkdirs
review_mkdirs: review the mkdirs function to understand how it handles both list and single path inputs
